fleet_aerial_fixture.basis: Test-only aerial Camera3D; original player/transport camera is restored immediately after capture.

scope: Production menu shortcut, fresh-E wait/board/reserved exit, live source-road bus motion. Safe player door pose is labelled fixture. Bus transforms are never test-assigned. Native captures are actual viewport pixels; aerial inspection frame is explicitly a fixture. Long812m occupied/endpoint-camera stress remains a separate acceptance artifact.

route_certificate.terrain_support: EXP21 existing physical TIN; no bus-only plane

whole_box_preflight.legacy_queue_zone: Every sedan box at the original coverage_drive_1 endpoint and 0..15m behind it, with 5cm margin; original actors/route/guard unchanged.
whole_box_preflight.notes: Source-display estimated widths and authored lanes, not surveyed bus swept-path approval. Southern U-turn is authored before the exact node connector to avoid original vehicle endpoint parking. Native terrain/full-box checks remain mandatory.

stop_clearance.scope: Planar full visual/physical stop footprint exclusion; native TIN, capsule/LOS, actual crossing walk and camera checks are separate.

snapshot.scope: Three source-road physical closed-loop buses; four game-authored stops. Every stop boards/alights. No endpoint recycle or position jump. ETA is an actual local-state estimate with traffic delay, not a live Seoul schedule.
